blocks.content: Course: Build your First Web App with React
So you've added your header and entry cards. Now you need a way for users to add new entries.
In this lesson, you'll build a form component with:

items: A text input for the title
A button to submit the entry

blocks.content: The form won't work yet (you'll do that in the next chapter). For now, let's just focus on building the UI.
We'll start by creating a separate component for the form, and then proceed to add it to our main React app.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
